featured_reviews.name: Bhavvik Sanghvi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Testimonial for Strategic Execution & Retail Expansion – Rings & I

Dear Niranjan,

As the Founder & Owner of 3 Solutions, where I specialize in supplying premium mobile numbers to entrepreneurs and active businesses, I understand the value of positioning, precision, and long-term brand building.

In June 2025, I had the opportunity to connect you with Mr. Rohit, CEO of Rings & I, at a pivotal stage of their retail expansion journey.

What followed is a strong example of what happens when the right referral meets the right execution partner.

Since that introduction, NSA Architects has successfully executed Phase 1 and Phase 2 of the Oshiwara Flagship Store, delivered Phase 1 of the Borivali Store, and efficiently coordinated the successful completion of Phase 3 – the main interior works.

What stands out is not just the design language, but the discipline behind it. Retail execution demands structured coordination, vendor control, timeline integrity, and brand consistency — and NSA delivered on all fronts.

The Oshiwara flagship today reflects a clean, premium, experience-led format that aligns perfectly with the Rings & I growth vision.

If I were to describe NSA Architects’ contribution in three words:

PRECISION | ACCOUNTABILITY | SCALE-READY EXECUTION

As a BNI member, it gives me immense satisfaction to see a referral convert into measurable impact and expansion.

I am proud to have made this introduction and would confidently recommend NSA Architects to any brand looking to scale with clarity and control.

Wishing you continued success.

Thank you.

Regards,
Bhavvik Sanghvi
Founder & Owner – 3 Solutions

featured_reviews.name: Nirakar Malla
featured_reviews.review_text:
Working with NSA Architects has been an absolute pleasure!

We recently had the opportunity to collaborate with Niranjan Shinde and his incredibly talented team on their award-winning project — Chandrashilp 2.0. As a specialist in stretch ceiling installations, we’ve worked with many design firms, but NSA truly stands out.

Their approach to design is not only innovative but extremely well-coordinated and detail-driven. Right from the initial brief to the final execution, the team ensured seamless communication, crystal-clear drawings, and a deep respect for every vendor’s craft.

The level of professionalism, site management, and design clarity made our work efficient and enjoyable. What impressed us most was their ability to push creative boundaries while keeping practicality in mind — a rare balance in today’s fast-paced projects.

It’s no surprise that Chandrashilp 2.0 earned national recognition — the project is a testament to NSA's commitment to excellence.

Looking forward to many more landmark collaborations in the future!

Highly recommended to anyone looking for visionary architects who deliver, down to the finest detail.

Nirakar  Malla
ZenCeil — Stretch Ceiling Specialists
